definition: I. צָרַח verb cry, roar (Late Hebrew id., cry (of raven); Assyrian ƒarâ—u , cry aloud , Arabic Ethiopic ᵑ7 צְרַח Aph`el (of bear), Syriac especially Aph`el and derivatives ); — Qal Participle active מַר צֹרֵחַ שָׁם גִּבּוֺר Zeph 1:14 bitterly roareth there a hero , but abrupt in context and improbable; Gr (in part after ᵐ5 ) conjectures יִצְרַח כַּגִּבּוֺר ׳ קוֺל י (compare Hiph`il ). Hiph`il Imperfect 3 masculine singular יַצְרִיחַ Isa 42:13 utter a roar (of ׳ י , going to battle; || יָרִיעַ ).

I. צָרַח verb cry, roar (Late Hebrew id., cry (of raven); Assyrian ƒarâ—u, cry aloud, Arabic Ethiopic ᵑ7 צְרַח Aph`el (of bear), Syriac especially Aph`el and derivatives ); —

Qal Participle active מַר צֹרֵחַ שָׁם גִּבּוֺר Zeph 1:14 bitterly roareth there a hero, but abrupt in context and improbable; Gr (in part after ᵐ5) conjectures יִצְרַח כַּגִּבּוֺר ׳קוֺל י (compare Hiph`il). Hiph`il Imperfect 3 masculine singular יַצְרִיחַ Isa 42:13 utter a roar (of ׳י, going to battle; || יָרִיעַ).
